name: than
sentence: Faith is stronger than reason.
sentenceTrans: 信仰比理智更有力。

name: scarf
sentence: Her scarf streamed behind her.
sentenceTrans: 她的围巾在身后飘动。

name: blow
sentence: Blow! I completely forgot it.
sentenceTrans: 哎呀！我给忘得一干二净了。

name: take
sentence: I'll take my coat upstairs. Shall I take yours, Roberta?
sentenceTrans: 我将把我的外套拿到楼上去。要我把你的拿上去吗，罗伯塔？

name: Unit11
sentence: Unit11 Sad movies made me cry.
sentenceTrans: 悲伤的电影使我哭泣。

name: Western
sentence: Most Western societies are liberal in outlook.
sentenceTrans: 西方社会大多思想观念开放。

name: turkey
sentence: Who's going to carve the turkey?
sentenceTrans: 谁来把火鸡切成小块？

name: bright
sentence: Bright colours are his signature.
sentenceTrans: 他总爱用亮丽的色彩。

name: laugh
sentence: He uttered a snorting laugh.
sentenceTrans: 他扑哧一声笑了。

name: jack-o’-lantern
sentence: Today let me show you some simple instructions to carve a traditional Jack-o'-lantern.
sentenceTrans: 今天来跟我一起学做一盏传统样式的南瓜灯吧。

name: Unit12
sentence: Unit12 what is red and what is black?
sentenceTrans: 什么是红的和什么是黑的？

name: pea
sentence: The tumour had shrunk to the size of a pea.
sentenceTrans: 肿瘤已缩小到豌豆大小。

name: pod
sentence: Apple Home Pod has Siri, Google Home has its Assistant, and the upcoming Galaxy Home device will have Bixby.
sentenceTrans: Apple Home Pod 有 Siri，谷歌 Home 有助手，而即将推出的 Galaxy Home 设备将配备 Bixby。

name: forever
sentence: Our luck couldn't hold forever.
sentenceTrans: 我们的好运不可能永远保持不变。

name: bigger
sentence: The bigger boys started scrapping.
sentenceTrans: 年龄较大的男孩打了起来。

name: excited
sentence: His eyes were bright and excited.
sentenceTrans: 他目光发亮，兴奋不已。

name: bullet
sentence: A bullet whizzed past my ear.
sentenceTrans: 一颗子弹嗖的一声从我耳边飞过。

name: lazy
sentence: He was not stupid, just lazy.
sentenceTrans: 他不笨，只是懒。

name: roof
sentence: How long would the roof hold?
sentenceTrans: 这屋顶还能支撑多久？

name: yard
sentence: Which door leads to the yard?
sentenceTrans: 哪扇门通向庭院？

name: hit
sentence: The ferry hit us amidships.
sentenceTrans: 渡轮拦腰撞了我们的船只。

name: see
sentence: I see things differently now.
sentenceTrans: 现在，我看问题的方法不一样了。

name: one
trans: by one 一个接一个地
sentence: Knit one row, purl one row.
sentenceTrans: 织一趟平针，织一趟反针。

name: look
sentence: You look absolutely stunning!
sentenceTrans: 你看上去漂亮极了。
